WITH relevant_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.movie_id = mc.movie_id
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
    WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title'
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS member_in_charnamed_movie
FROM cast_info AS ci
JOIN relevant_movies AS rm ON ci.movie_id = rm.movie_id
JOIN title AS t ON ci.movie_id = t.id AND t.id = rm.movie_id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
WHERE n.name LIKE '%B%'
